title: Pianos under the pads, and the site's look
thisBuild: Hold a pad (or tap Keys under the grid) to drop a piano for that pad below the pads. Up to four at once, every pad still there.
The pianos show an octave and a half at a time, C3 to C5 in all; slide across keys, play chords with more than one finger, and ◀ ▶ shifts the range. Chords and scale shading follow the dock.
The whole app now looks like Neat Shit and Dye: square cream buttons with pink shadows, Bungee headings, the dark lab, a bit louder.
From the site: Hush, Bottle it, Loop/Song in the top bar, 1 bar to 2 bars copies bar one, roll note lengths up to a whole bar, Clear notes, Rough it in.
Every screen now runs through an automatic test on each build.
watch: Open two pianos for two pads and play both at once.
Hold Stutter and Tape stop while a loop plays.
If anything feels slow, send a Tuning note from the 🐞 right away so the speed numbers go with it.
limits: Creature cards, the Ring, jams and duels stay on the site.
It stops playing a while after you leave the app.
